summary: N-able, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Third Amendment to its existing Credit Agreement, adding a delayed draw term loan facility of up to $75 million. The facility is fungible with existing term loans, with a six-month draw period and floating SOFR-based interest plus 2.75% margin (down to 2.50% at lower leverage). Proceeds may fund general corporate purposes, deferred consideration from a prior acquisition, acquisitions, or share repurchases. No special-situation categorization applies: this is a routine debt amendment, not a transformative event.
